audience: tour and activity operators who check availability, bookings and day manifests in Zaui

useCases.title: See which activities run on a date
useCases.text: List the activities that run on one date, with their category. Check the available places of one activity for each of its times.

useCases.title: Read the day manifest
useCases.text: List every booking for every activity on one date. For one activity, list only its bookings for one start time. The result lists guest names.

useCases.title: Find a booking by number, name or mobile
useCases.text: Get one booking by its confirmation number to see its status and balance. Search by guest name or mobile number when you lack the number. Use these tools for the customer's own bookings only.

useCases.title: Check product stock for a quantity
useCases.text: List the catalog to find a product's ID. Then check the stock of that product for the number of items you need.
